description: Exploit throughput on the batch axis (E024: 1024 to 1536 gave -3.1%; E028: 1536 to 2048 gave -3.9%, both with accuracy flat). On tip E028, change only the batch size, from 2048 to 3072. Hold the per-example LR and wd fixed for the SGD-trained parameters (per-step LR x1.5). Treat the Muon lr exactly as E028's 1536-to-2048 change did (check the commit and use the same convention). Tie warmup/decay, Lookahead and Muon schedules to the new step count, recapture both resolution graphs in build, and handle the last partial batch the same way as now. Report per-seed accuracy and the total step count (about 155).
